methodologyNotes: Prices fetched from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Where the official page returned no renderable USD prices (Hootsuite — JS-gated), figures were taken from GetApp and corroborated by a 2026 Social Champ blog review. Sprout Social Standard/Professional/Advanced annual-billing discount is not publicly disclosed; prices shown are the listed per-seat/month figures (confirmed annual commitment by Social Champ). Later monthly (non-annual) prices derived from the stated '25% off' annual discount. Metricool prices are the monthly-billing USD rates; annual billing saves up to 24%. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null for every plan as this is a non-telephony vertical. Enterprise/custom tiers are included with monthlyUsd=null. accessedAt is 2026-06-14 on all sources.

vendors.name: Hootsuite
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (hootsuite.com/plans) rendered no USD amounts (JS-gated). Prices sourced from GetApp (getapp.com/content-management-software/a/hootsuite/pricing/) and corroborated by Social Champ blog (socialchamp.com/blog/hootsuite-pricing/). Both secondary sources confirm $99/user/month (Standard) and $249/user/month (Advanced) on annual-only billing.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Annual billing only; no monthly billing option. Up to 10 social accounts, unlimited post scheduling, AI assistant, 1 user. Price per user/month billed annually.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Annual billing only; no monthly billing option. Unlimited social accounts, customizable analytics, bulk schedule 350 posts, 1+ users. Price per user/month billed annually.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; contact sales. Includes SSO, unlimited users, employee advocacy, advanced analytics, AI chatbot, Salesforce integration.

vendors.name: Buffer
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (buffer.com/pricing) fetched directly. Prices are per channel per month. Annual billing saves 20%; $5 and $10 are annual rates ($6.25 and $12.50 month-to-month). Volume discounts apply for channels 11+.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts per channel, 100 ideas, AI assistant, 30-day analytics history.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Price is per channel per month on annual billing ($60/channel/year). Month-to-month rate is ~$6.25/channel. Unlimited scheduled posts, advanced analytics, hashtag manager, first comment scheduling. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Price is per channel per month on annual billing ($120/channel/year). Month-to-month rate is ~$12.50/channel. Unlimited users, approval workflows, custom access permissions, branded reports. 14-day free trial.

vendors.name: Sprout Social
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (sproutsocial.com/pricing/) fetched directly. Essentials: $79/seat/month annual, $99/seat/month monthly confirmed from official page. Standard, Professional, Advanced prices ($199/$299/$399) are annual-commitment per-seat/month rates per official page and corroborated by Social Champ blog review. Annual discount for Standard+ plans not disclosed publicly.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Annual billing: $79/seat/month. Monthly billing: $99/seat/month. Up to 5 social profiles, optimal send times, profile and post-level reporting.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Annual commitment required. $199/seat/month. 5 social profiles, consolidated inbox, keyword and location monitoring, review management.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Annual commitment required. $299/seat/month. Unlimited social profiles, message tagging, competitor insights, paid insights, AI Assist for posts.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Annual commitment required. $399/seat/month. AI Assist for replies, sentiment analysis, Sprout API, helpdesk integrations, team productivity reports, message spike alerts.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; contact sales / request demo. Includes white-glove onboarding, dedicated SSO, priority support.

vendors.name: Later
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (later.com/pricing/) fetched directly. Prices shown ($18.75, $37.50, $82.50) are annual billing rates (billed yearly, 3 months free / 25% off). Monthly billing rates derived: annual rate / 0.75. Monthly toggle present on page but monthly figures did not render in fetched content.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Month-to-month price: $25/month. Annual billing: $18.75/month ($225/year). 1 user, 1 social set (8 profiles), 30 posts/profile/month, 5 AI credits/month, 3-month analytics history.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Month-to-month price: $50/month. Annual billing: $37.50/month ($450/year). 2 users, 2 social sets (16 profiles), 180 posts/profile/month, social inbox, collaboration, 50 AI credits/month, 1-year analytics history.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Month-to-month price: $110/month. Annual billing: $82.50/month ($990/year). 4 users, 6 social sets (48 profiles), unlimited posts, competitive benchmarking, 100 AI credits/month, 2-year analytics history, priority support. Additional users $3.75/month each (annual rate).

vendors.name: SocialBee
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (socialbee.com/pricing/) fetched directly. Monthly prices confirmed; annual prices confirmed with 16% discount. Annual monthly-equivalents verified from page (Bootstrap $24.2, Accelerate $40.8, Pro $82.5, Pro50 $149.2, Pro100 $274.2, Pro150 $374.2).

plans.name: Bootstrap
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $29/month. Annual billing: ~$24.20/month ($290/year). 1 user, 1 workspace, 5 social profiles. For solopreneurs.

plans.name: Accelerate
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $49/month. Annual billing: ~$40.80/month ($490/year). 1 user, 1 workspace, 10 social profiles. Most popular plan.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $99/month. Annual billing: ~$82.50/month ($990/year). 3 users, 5 workspaces, 25 social profiles. For social media managers and teams.

plans.name: Pro50
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $179/month. Annual billing: ~$149.20/month ($1,792/year). 5 users, 10 workspaces, 50 social profiles. Agency plan.

plans.name: Pro100
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $329/month. Annual billing: ~$274.20/month ($3,288/year). 5 users, 20 workspaces, 100 social profiles. Agency plan.

plans.name: Pro150
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $449/month. Annual billing: ~$374.20/month ($4,488/year). 5 users, 30 workspaces, 150 social profiles. Agency plan.

vendors.name: Sendible
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (sendible.com/pricing) fetched directly. Monthly prices and annual totals both confirmed. Annual monthly-equivalents: Creator $25 ($300/yr), Traction $76 ($912/yr), Scale $170 ($2,040/yr), Advanced $255 ($3,060/yr), Enterprise $638 ($7,656/yr). Savings confirmed on page.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $29/month. Annual billing: $25/month ($300/year, saves $48). 1 user, 6 social profiles. For freelancers and solo businesses.

plans.name: Traction
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $89/month. Annual billing: $76/month ($912/year, saves $156). 4 users, 24 social profiles. Team collaboration, client dashboards.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $199/month. Annual billing: $170/month ($2,040/year, saves $348). 7 users, 49 social profiles. Most popular. Custom/automated reports, content library, campaigns, account manager.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $299/month. Annual billing: $255/month ($3,060/year, saves $528). Up to 20 users (customizable to 35), 100 profiles (to 175). White label available as add-on.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $750/month. Annual billing: $638/month ($7,656/year, saves $1,344). Up to 80 users (customizable to 95), 400 profiles (to 475). Dedicated success management, optional SSO. For large agencies and franchises.

vendors.name: Metricool
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page (metricool.com/pricing/) fetched directly. Prices shown are monthly billing USD rates. Annual billing saves up to 24%. Multiple Starter and Advanced sub-tiers confirmed ($20/$36 for Starter, $53/$85/$159 for Advanced). Custom plan requires contact sales.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 brand, 20 posts/month, 5 competitor profiles, 30-day analytics, AI assistant.

plans.name: Starter 5
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $20/month. Annual billing saves up to 24%. Up to 5 brands, unlimited publishing, 100 competitor profiles, LinkedIn access, PDF/PPT reports.

plans.name: Starter 10

plans.name: Advanced 15
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $53/month. Annual billing saves up to 24%. Up to 15 brands, team management, post approval system, full Twitter/X analytics, Looker Studio connector, API access.

plans.name: Advanced 25
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $85/month. Annual billing saves up to 24%. Up to 25 brands, team management, post approval, full analytics, API access.

plans.name: Advanced 50
plans.notes: Monthly billing: $159/month. Annual billing saves up to 24%. Up to 50 brands, team management, post approval, full analytics, API access.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Contact sales. Includes white label, dedicated account manager, custom AI credits, business integrations. Brands count custom.
